pages.title: Good as New
pages.text: Repair a damaged tool or weapon using a normal Anvil.

pages.title: Good as New
pages.text: Keep a favorite item useful; the reward supplies a small further repair reserve.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Use the installed anvil recipe and take a result with lower damage than the input. A rename without repairing damage does not count.

pages.title: How to use it
pages.text: Insert items and close the anvil screen. Inputs remain stored and are rendered on the block instead of returning immediately to the player.

pages.title: How to use it
pages.text: Use the anvil's rename field, optionally applying supported formatting codes. The mod advertises free renaming and formatted names, subject to configuration.

pages.title: How to use it
pages.text: Inspect gear repair/enchantment costs and use iron blocks to restore a damaged anvil. Prior-work penalties, book costs and anvil durability are configurable upstream changes.
